question: Which of the following organisms belong to the Phylum Protozoa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amoeba, Paramecium, Taenia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amoeba, Paramecium, Plasmodium** belong to the Phylum Protozoa.
 
• Protozoa are single-celled eukaryotic organisms that can be free-living or parasitic.
 
• They are characterized by their ability to move independently, often using cilia, flagella, or pseudopodia.
 
• Protozoa are found in a variety of habitats, including freshwater, marine environments, and soil.
 
• They play a significant role in the ecosystem, including decomposing organic material and serving as a food source for other organisms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Euglena** is often classified under the Phylum Euglenozoa, not Protozoa.
 
• **Jelly fish** belong to the Phylum Cnidaria, which is completely different from Protozoa.
 
• **Taenia** is a genus of tapeworms, which are classified under the Phylum Platyhelminthes.
 
• The classification of organisms into different phyla is based on their unique structural and functional characteristics.
 
• Understanding the phylum of an organism helps in studying its biology, ecology, and evolutionary history.
